data.exact_reserve_text: The 2016 Year of Account has performed creditably given that it was affected by Hurricane Matthew and fires in Alberta, the year is forecast to be better than plan when it closes in 12 months time with a return of stamp of 11.9%. This is despite challenging market conditions that continued to erode profit margins and premium volumes. The 2015 Year of Account has performed well and has returned a return on stamp of 16.1% thanks to a benign period of losses and a stronger rating environment than that experienced in 2017.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported a gross prior year reserve release of GBP 5.3 million for the 2017 financial year, primarily driven by favorable claims development on the 2015 and 2016 years of account. The 2015 year of account performed well due to a benign period of losses, while the 2016 year of account performed creditably despite being affected by Hurricane Matthew and fires in Alberta.
